proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s₁ s₂ h1 h2 hd
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.isExtTangent_iff_dist_center.mpr ⟨hd, h1.le, h2.le⟩
  have key : ∀ Q : P, Q ∈ s₁ → Q ∈ s₂ → (s₁.radius + s₂.radius) • (Q -ᵥ s₁.center) = s₁.radius • (s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center) := by
    intro Q hQ1 hQ2
    have nx : ‖Q -ᵥ s₁.center‖ = s₁.radius := by rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub V]; exact hQ1
    have ny : ‖s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center‖ = s₁.radius + s₂.radius := by rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub V, dist_comm]; exact hd
    have nz : ‖(s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center) - (Q -ᵥ s₁.center)‖ = s₂.radius := by
      rw [vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub V, dist_comm]; exact hQ2
    have hin : inner ℝ (Q -ᵥ s₁.center) (s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center) = ‖Q -ᵥ s₁.center‖ * ‖s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center‖ := by
      have h3 := norm_sub_sq_real (s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center) (Q -ᵥ s₁.center)
      rw [nz, ny, nx, real_inner_comm] at h3
      rw [ny, nx]
      linear_combination (1 / 2) * h3
    have h4 := inner_eq_norm_mul_iff_real.mp hin
    rw [ny, nx] at h4
    exact h4
  refine ⟨T, ⟨hT.mem_left, hT.mem_right⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro Q ⟨hQ1, hQ2⟩
  have e := (key Q hQ1 hQ2).trans (key T hT.mem_left hT.mem_right).symm
  have hne : s₁.radius + s₂.radius ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have := smul_right_injective V hne e
  exact vsub_left_injective _ this
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s₁ s₂ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P), 0 < s₁.radius → 0 < s₂.radius → dist s₁.center s₂.center = s₁.radius + s₂.radius → ∃! T : P, T ∈ s₁ ∧ T ∈ s₂
